results.title: A phone: the old reader's phone shell
results.checks: On an iPhone 13: a thin bar at the top (the translation, then ☆, bookmark, share and text settings), the chapter's title centred and large (John over a big 3), and along the bottom play and the chapter pill ‹ John 3 › above the five tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More, with Bible lit. The pill's › goes to John 4 and its label opens the book picker; Bible on the text opens it too. More → Tabs opens the Tabs drawer, which closes with its ✕ and with a tap beside it; reading down scrolls the page itself; signed out, You carries the count of changes waiting and opens the sign-in pane
results.note: top bar: 5 buttons; title "John 3"; tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More; › and the pill and Bible worked; the Tabs drawer closed by ✕ and by a tap beside it; the page scrolled; You carried the waiting count and opened sign-in
